title: Made in Indonesia
goals: membentuk **passive voice** dengan [[am / is / are + past participle]] dan [[was / were + past participle]]
mengubah kalimat aktif menjadi pasif dan sebaliknya
membaca teks tentang produk dan tempat di Indonesia

lesson.text: Bandingkan: "Ibu memasak nasi" dan "Nasi dimasak oleh ibu." Keduanya benar, tetapi sudut pandangnya berbeda. Yang pertama **aktif** (menekankan pelaku), yang kedua **pasif** (menekankan benda atau hasil). Di **Unit 3 Kelas 9** kamu belajar membuat kalimat pasif.

lesson.title: 1. Aktif atau pasif?
table: subjek + **to be + past participle** (+ by pelaku)

lesson.title: Kapan memakai pasif?
lesson.text: Pasif dipakai jika **pelaku tidak diketahui**, **tidak penting**, atau kita ingin **menekankan benda/hasilnya**: [[Batik is made in Indonesia.]] (siapa yang membuat tidak penting).

items.ex: The movie was seen by many people.
Tea is drunk hot or cold.
English is spoken in many countries.
Fruit is sold at the market.
The room is cleaned every day.

lesson.title: Kata kerja beraturan dan tidak beraturan
lesson.text: Kata kerja **beraturan**: bentuk ketiga = bentuk lampau (**-ed**), misalnya *clean → cleaned*, *paint → painted*. Kata kerja **tidak beraturan** harus dihafal (made, written, eaten, built, taken, given).

lesson.title: 3. Passive voice: simple present dan simple past
table: [[Rice is grown in Indonesia.]] / [[These shoes are made in Bandung.]]
[[The temple was built hundreds of years ago.]] / [[The windows were broken.]]

examples.en: Negatif: [[The room isn't cleaned every day.]] / [[The book wasn't written by him.]]
Pertanyaan: [[Is rice grown in Bali?]] — [[Yes, it is.]] / [[Were the photos taken by Dina?]] — [[No, they weren't.]]

lesson.title: 4. Mengubah aktif menjadi pasif (3 langkah)
lesson.text:
Ikuti tiga langkah ini:
**1.** Objek kalimat aktif menjadi **subjek** kalimat pasif.
**2.** Kata kerja menjadi **to be + past participle** (to be mengikuti subjek baru dan tense-nya).
**3.** Subjek aktif menjadi **by + pelaku** (boleh dihilangkan).
table: dinner → subjek; cooks → is cooked; my mother → by my mother
the window → subjek; broke → was broken; Budi → by Budi
English → subjek; speak → is spoken (pelaku umum dihilangkan)

lesson.title: Perhatikan jumlah subjek
lesson.text: To be mengikuti **subjek baru**. Satu benda → **is/was**. Banyak benda → **are/were**. Contoh: [[The cake is made.]] tetapi [[The cakes are made.]]

lesson.title: 5. Contoh tentang Indonesia
table: [[Batik is made in many parts of Java.]]
Batik dibuat di banyak daerah di Jawa.
[[Rendang is cooked with coconut milk and spices.]]
Rendang dimasak dengan santan dan rempah.
[[Rice is grown in many parts of Indonesia.]]
Padi ditanam di banyak daerah di Indonesia.
[[The Proclamation of Independence was read on August 17th, 1945.]]
[[Indonesian is spoken all over the country.]]
Bahasa Indonesia dituturkan di seluruh negeri.

items: Pasif = **to be + past participle**. Present: [[is / are + V3]]. Past: [[was / were + V3]].
Pelaku dengan [[by]] (boleh dihilangkan jika tidak penting).
Aktif → pasif: objek jadi subjek, kata kerja jadi to be + V3, subjek jadi by + pelaku.
Past participle: [[make → made]], [[write → written]], [[eat → eaten]], [[build → built]].
